# Option index

<!-- Generated by scripts/generate_option_index.py from saveinstance.luau. -->

Searchable names, types, descriptions, and defaults extracted from the primary source.
These describe the implementation; they do not establish runtime compatibility.

See the [full API reference](/api/CompleteSaveInstance) for aliases and function signatures.
Preset overrides are listed in [Script Presets](PRESETS.md).

## __DEBUG_MODE

Type: `boolean`. Source default: `false`.

This will print debug logs to console about unusual scenarios. Recommended to enable if you wish to help us improve our products and find bugs / issues with it!

## ReadMe

Type: `boolean`. Source default: `true`.

Includes an embedded help document with export notes and limitations.

## Binary

Type: `boolean`. Source default: `true`.

Saves as a binary file (.rbxl/.rbxm) instead of XML (.rbxlx/.rbxmx). Much smaller and faster to load. Pass `XML = true` for the opposite.

## CompressionMode

Type: `string | boolean`. Source default: `"zstd"`.

How chunks are compressed in binary mode: "zstd", "lz4", or false for none.

## CompressionLevel

Type: `number`. Source default: `9`.

Compression strength, higher is smaller but slower. Range is -7 to 22 inclusive.

## CopyToClipboard

Type: `boolean`. Source default: `false`.

Puts the finished output on the clipboard instead of writing a file, so you can paste it straight into Studio. Best for small saves -- a full place is usually far too big for the clipboard to handle.

## RiskyServicesDisabled

Type: `{UGC, Encoding, Reflection = boolean}`. Source default: `{UGC = true, Encoding = false, Reflection = false}`.

Per-service kill switches for services games might detect. `UGC` skips UGCValidationService (GHP fallback reads, `MeshPart.VertexCount`). `Encoding` skips EncodingService (base64 encode/decode, zstd compression falls back to other funcs). `Reflection` skips ReflectionService (one of several API dump fallbacks, `Content` property lookups -- falls back to the other API dump sources). Examples: `{UGC = true}` disables only UGCValidationService; `{Encoding = true, Reflection = true}` disables both, leaving UGC untouched.

## SafeMode

Type: `boolean`. Source default: `false`.

Deliberately disconnects the client before saving and may enable script termination and rendering changes. It does not guarantee protection.

## KillAllScripts

Type: `boolean`. Source default: `false`.

Attempts to terminate other client scripts. SafeMode can enable this implicitly; it can prevent movement and disrupt the client.

## BoostFPS

Type: `boolean`. Source default: `false`.

Massively boosts FPS by disabling 3D rendering. Other options also enable it, like: SafeMode.

## ShutdownWhenDone

Type: `boolean`. Source default: `false`.

Shuts the game down after saveinstance is finished.

## AntiIdle

Type: `boolean`. Source default: `true`.

Prevents the 20-minute-Idle Kick.

## Anonymous

Type: `{boolean|table{UserId = string?, Name = string?}}`. Source default: `false`.

* **RISKY:** Removes your Name and UserId from the file -- useful for games that store them in GUIs or other Instances. Can also be a table with UserId and/or Name keys to pick the replacements. May mess up unrelated text or numbers that happen to match. Inside attributes and tags the replacement is padded to the same length, so a name shorter than yours comes out as for example `Roblox____`.

## ShowStatus

Type: `boolean`. Source default: `true`.

Displays the export progress interface while the engine runs.

## Callback

Type: `function`. Source default: `false`.

If set, the serialized data will be sent to the callback function instead of to file.

## mode

Type: `string`. Source default: `"optimized"`.

Valid modes: full, optimized, scripts. Change this to invalid mode like "invalid" if you only want ExtraInstances. "optimized" mode is **NOT** supported with *@Object* option.

## Decompile

Type: `boolean`. Source default: `true`.

Script decompiling.

## scriptcache

Type: `boolean`. Source default: `true`.

Use decompiled script cache to avoid decompiling duplicate scripts.

## DecompileTimeout

Type: `number`. Source default: `10`.

If the decompilation run time exceeds this value it gets cancelled. Set to -1 to disable timeout.

## BytecodeTimeout

Type: `number`. Source default: `3`.

If the SaveBytecode run time exceeds this value it gets cancelled. Set to -1 to disable timeout.

## DecompileJobless

Type: `boolean`. Source default: `false`.

Includes already decompiled code in the output. No new scripts are decompiled.

## SaveBytecode

Type: `boolean`. Source default: `false`.

Includes bytecode in the output. Useful if you wish to be able to decompile it yourself later. Respects **@DecompileIgnore**.

## DecompileIgnore

Type: `{Instance | Instance.ClassName | [Instance.ClassName] = {Instance.Name}}`. Source default: `{TextChatService}`.

Ignores matched instances and their descendants by default. To ignore only the instance itself, set the value to `false`. Examples: `"Chat"` matches any instance with ClassName "Chat"; `Players = {"MyPlayerName"}` matches class "Players" AND name "MyPlayerName" only; `workspace` matches a specific instance by reference; `[workspace] = false` matches a specific instance by reference, ignoring only itself and not its descendants.

## IgnoreList

Type: `{Instance | Instance.ClassName | [Instance.ClassName] = {Instance.Name | false}}`. Source default: `{CoreGui, CorePackages, Packages = false}`.

Structure mirrors **@DecompileIgnore**, except `false` means keep the instance but ignore its descendants. Supports both instance references and ClassName strings. Examples: `"CoreGui"` skips entirely; `CorePackages = false` keeps the instance but skips its descendants; `Players = {"SomePlayer"}` skips a specific named instance with specific ClassName.

## ExtraInstances

Type: `{Instance}`. Source default: `{}`.

If used with any invalid mode (like "invalidmode") it will only save these instances.

## IgnoreProperties

Type: `table`. Source default: `{}`.

Ignores properties by Name.

## SaveCacheInterval

Type: `number`. Source default: `0x1600 * 10`.

The less the value the more often it saves, but that would mean less performance due to constantly saving. XML Only.

## FilePath

Type: `string`. Source default: `false`.

The name (can include a path) of the file to save to. If it has no extension, `.rbxmx/rbxm` (models) or `.rbxlx/rbxl` (places) is appended; an existing extension is left as-is. Ignores `OPTIONS.AvoidFileOverwrite`.

## AvoidFileOverwrite

Type: `boolean`. Source default: `true`.

Prevents writing to place file that already exists.

## Object

Type: `Instance`. Source default: `false`.

* If provided, saves as .rbxmx (Model file) instead. If Object is game, it will be saved as a .rbxl file. **MUST BE AN INSTANCE REFERENCE, FOR EXAMPLE - *game.Workspace***. `"optimized"` mode is **NOT** supported with this option. If IsModel is set to false then Object specified here will be saved as a place file.

## IsModel

Type: `boolean`. Source default: `false`.

If Object is specified then sets to true automatically, unless you set it to false.

## NilInstances

Type: `boolean`. Source default: `false`.

Save instances that aren't Parented (Parented to nil).

## NilInstancesFixes

Type: `{[Instance.ClassName] = function}`. Source default: `{Animator = function, AdPortal = function, BaseWrap = function, Attachment = function}`.

* This can cause some Classes to be fixed even though they might not need the fix (better be safe than sorry though). For example, Bones inherit from Attachment if we dont define them in the NilInstancesFixes then this will catch them anyways. **TO AVOID THIS BEHAVIOR USE THIS EXAMPLE:** \{ClassName_That_Doesnt_Need_Fix = false\}.

## IgnoreDefaultProperties

Type: `boolean`. Source default: `true`.

Ignores default properties during saving. XML Only (XML=true) because Binary (default) doesn't really need it.

## IgnoreNotArchivable

Type: `boolean`. Source default: `true`.

Ignores the Archivable property and saves Non-Archivable instances.

## IgnorePropertiesOfNotScriptsOnScriptsMode

Type: `boolean`. Source default: `false`.

Ignores property of every instance that is not a script in "scripts" mode.

## IgnoreSpecialProperties

Type: `boolean`. Source default: `false`.

Prevents calls to `gethiddenproperty` and uses fallback methods instead. This also helps with crashes. If your file is corrupted after saving, you can try turning this on.

## IsolateStarterPlayer

Type: `boolean`. Source default: `false`.

Saves StarterPlayer as separate folder, children of the original instance will be ignored.

## IsolatePlayers

Type: `boolean`. Source default: `false`.

Saves All Players as separate folder, children of the original instance will be ignored.

## IsolateLocalPlayer

Type: `boolean`. Source default: `false`.

Saves LocalPlayer as separate folder, original instance will be ignored.

## IsolateLocalPlayerCharacter

Type: `boolean`. Source default: `false`.

Saves LocalPlayer.Character as separate folder, original instance will be ignored.

## SavePlayerCharacters

Type: `boolean`. Source default: `false`.

Save player characters while saving.

## SaveNotCreatable

Type: `boolean`. Source default: `false`.

* Includes non-serializable instances as Folder objects (Name is misleading as this is mostly a fix for certain NilInstances and isn't always related to NotCreatable). Other options also enable it, like: IsolatePlayers, IsolateLocalPlayer, etc.

## NotCreatableFixes

Type: `table<Instance.ClassName>`. Source default: `{ "", "Player", "PlayerScripts", "PlayerGui", "TouchTransmitter" }`.

* \{"Player"\} is the same as \{Player = "Folder"\}; Format like \{SpawnLocation = "Part"\} is only to be used when SpawnLocation inherits from "Part" AND "Part" is Creatable.

## AlternativeWritefile

Type: `boolean`. Source default: `true`.

* Splits file content string into segments and writes them using appendfile. This might help with crashes when it starts writing to file. Though there is a risk of appendfile working incorrectly on some execs.

## IgnoreDefaultPlayerScripts

Type: `boolean`. Source default: `true`.

* **RISKY**: Ignores Default PlayerScripts like PlayerModule & RbxCharacterSounds. Prevents crashes on some execs.

## SharedBinaryStrings

Type: `boolean`. Source default: `false`.

Stores BinaryString values in a shared pool so identical ones are only written once, instead of repeating them for every instance. Good when many instances hold the same data (like copies of the same mesh) -- can make files noticeably smaller. Slightly bigger when everything is unique. Roblox doesn't officially support this, so there's a small chance it confuses Studio.

## TreatUnionsAsParts

Type: `boolean`. Source default: `false (except Solara)`.

* **RISKY:** Converts all UnionOperations to Parts. Useful if your Executor isn't able to save (read) Unions, because otherwise they will be invisible.
